reasoning: The graph contains parallel edges between the same pair of vertices (two edges linking each corresponding vertex of consecutive cliques). Any labeling gives the same absolute difference for both parallel edges, violating the requirement that all edge labels be distinct. Hence no graceful labeling exists.
